name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2813: REG-753 - the routine that protects his board would have deleted it. Measured before touching: the record present was his console live world claim - firstSeen nine seconds before the console started, seenCount 28, still being written, owner true and previous null so board_identity_drift reads ok. A blind rm degrades ok to unknown, which that function calls deliberate and NOT ok, and the next write starts a fresh install id with previous null - the shape that makes a real board render as a strangers world at 0 of 403. Sweep is now state-driven: guest and drifted swept with a backup, a healthy claim KEPT, absent reported UNKNOWN, unparseable never deleted, and it refuses while his console runs.
